title: Issue ACM certificates for CloudFront custom domains
description:
ACM certificates in us-east-1. DNS validation via Route 53 hosted zone.

Per environment hostname: chattic.us + www.chattic.us (prod); staging.chattic.us; dev.chattic.us. No separate API cert — /api is same distribution.

Wire cert ARNs into the web stack CloudFront distribution.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: ACM cert is created in `ChatticusDns` with DNS validation records in the hosted zone. Cert validates after GoDaddy NS delegation propagates.

comments.author: home
comments.text: ACM cert arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:335163751677:certificate/3887cf28-2f28-4898-987e-9d822d0db1ee ISSUED for chattic.us, www.chattic.us, *.chattic.us after NS propagation.
